back: Start in a small mountain village, equip your Crafter Kit and gather wood and stone for the first tower.
Ride down into three old mine workings and chip permanent cuts into the rock exactly where you aim.
Assemble a tower kit on the workshop platform, then climb to the overview table to choose its destination and send the wagon.
Defend the roads against soldiers and siege breakers, then ride out between waves to repair your towers.
Begin with Hand & Fire, with an optional walkthrough you can skip or reopen.
